bonus_rules.label: Founder or first operator
bonus_rules.description: Founded or was among the first operators of a company or program and owned delivery end to end; 2-4 if evidenced, otherwise 0. A side project alone does not qualify.

bonus_rules.label: Regulated or high-stakes domain
bonus_rules.description: Deployed or ran software in healthcare, public sector, social services, finance or legal settings where privacy or compliance rules applied; 2-3 if evidenced, otherwise 0.

bonus_rules.label: Linked demo or repository
bonus_rules.description: At least one deployed tool or workflow on the resume links to a live demo, demo video or repository; +2 if present, otherwise 0.

bonus_rules.label: LinkedIn profile
bonus_rules.description: LinkedIn profile in resume profiles; +1 if present, otherwise 0.
